Title supplied. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north to the bottom. Relief shown pictorially. Pictorial map. Shows the island of Hainan as viewed from the north and shows the customs and habits of the Li tribes in the central part of the island. Includes descriptive notes. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Previous call number: G7823.H25E62 1875 .H3 Vault AACR2
